groups.label: Road cycling
groups.description: Climbing terrain, rideable days, race-scene density, cyclist safety, wind and winter daylight.

groups.label: Climate
groups.description: Extreme heat penalized hardest, then summer humidity, precipitation and cold.

groups.label: Youth & growth
groups.description: Young-adult share, population growth and migration, singles market, remote-worker density.

groups.label: Economy & startups
groups.description: Tech concentration, employment growth, business formation, space-industry presence.

groups.label: Housing value
groups.description: Price vs. age/quality of stock, price and rent levels, property tax, insurance premiums.

groups.label: Safety
groups.description: CBSA-wide homicide rate only — the same measure for metros and micros.

groups.label: Airports & Tokyo
groups.description: Tokyo connectivity (nonstop + one-stop), proximity and size of local airports.

groups.label: Taxes & cost of living
groups.description: State income tax for a representative single filer at $110k wages, regional price level, EV home-charging cost.

groups.label: Environment & risk
groups.description: Wildfire smoke, natural-hazard expected losses, inversions, PM2.5, insurance-market stress.

groups.label: Education
groups.description: K-12 learning rate and achievement level (kept separate), research-university presence, college-town intensity.

groups.label: Catholic/Orthodox presence
groups.description: Bonus (up to +2): Orthodox and Catholic adherents per capita and Orthodox congregation growth.

groups.label: Altitude 4,000-8,200 ft
groups.description: Bonus (+2 flat) when the principal city sits in the altitude-training residence band.

metrics.label: Relief within 40 km
metrics.description: 95th minus 5th percentile of terrain elevation within 40 km of the principal city — the primary climbing-terrain proxy.

metrics.label: Climb area within 40 km
metrics.description: Share of land within 40 km at least 1,000 ft above the city elevation — terrain offering real climbs from town.

metrics.label: Relief within 80 km
metrics.description: Same relief measure over an 80 km radius — catches ranges a ride away (e.g. Denver's Front Range).

metrics.label: Climb area within 80 km
metrics.description: Share of land within 80 km at least 1,000 ft above the city elevation.

metrics.label: Rideable days per year
metrics.scoring_note: Raw value clipped to [180, 320] before ranking — a soft floor (a few indoor-trainer months are acceptable) and a soft cap (year-round warmth is not extra-rewarded); displayed value is unclipped.
metrics.description: Days per year meeting all of: 30-97°F max temperature, under 5 mm precipitation, no snow cover.

metrics.label: Race calendar within 100 mi
metrics.scoring_note: Prescored blend: score is the MAX of the USAC and BikeReg 100-mile percentile ranks (the platforms are regionally complementary, not summable). Displayed value is the larger of the two raw event counts.
metrics.description: Road/gravel races within a 100-mile race-weekend radius over the trailing 12 months, on the stronger of the two registration platforms.

metrics.label: Road races in the CBSA
metrics.description: USAC-sanctioned road events starting inside the CBSA in the trailing 12 months. Counts sanctioned races only — an area with a strong training scene can still score 0.

metrics.label: Cyclist fatality rate
metrics.description: Bicyclist traffic deaths per 100k residents per year, pooled 2020-2024. Per resident, not per cyclist-mile.

metrics.label: Windy days per year
metrics.scoring_note: 113/478 stations lack wind data; missing values imputed at the median of all scored areas before ranking (neutral).
metrics.description: Days per year with daily average wind at or above 18 mph.

metrics.label: Winter solstice daylight
metrics.description: Civil daylight hours on Dec 21 — how much of the off-season evening ride window survives.

metrics.label: Days lost to heat
metrics.description: Days per year with max temperature above 97°F — too hot for outdoor riding.

metrics.label: Jul-Aug 3pm dew point
metrics.description: Mean July-August afternoon dew point — the hot-AND-humid measure. 60-65°F is the caution band; areas at 65°F+ were screened out entirely.

metrics.label: Days lost to precipitation
metrics.description: Days per year lost to 5 mm+ precipitation (after heat/cold/snow attribution).

metrics.label: Days lost to cold
metrics.description: Days per year with max temperature below 30°F. Deliberately light weight — cold is preferred to heat.

metrics.label: Population share 25-34
metrics.description: Share of residents aged 25-34.

metrics.label: Population growth 2020-25
metrics.description: Total population growth 2020-2025.

metrics.label: Domestic migration rate
metrics.description: Net domestic migration 2020-2025 per 1,000 residents — where Americans are actually moving.

metrics.label: Never-married share 25-34
metrics.description: Share of 25-34-year-olds never married — singles-market proxy.

metrics.label: Sex ratio 25-39
metrics.description: Males per female aged 25-39; fewer men per woman scores better. Prison and military towns inflate this ratio.

metrics.label: Remote-worker share
metrics.description: Share of workers working from home — density of fellow remote workers.

metrics.label: College share 25-34
metrics.description: Share of 25-34-year-olds holding a bachelor's degree or higher.

metrics.label: Tech job concentration
metrics.description: Tech-industry location quotient vs. the US (software, computing infrastructure, R&D, electronics mfg).

metrics.label: Employment growth 2019-25
metrics.scoring_note: 2 CT CBSAs lack a 2019 baseline (county-FIPS transition); missing values imputed at the median of all scored areas before ranking (neutral).
metrics.description: Covered-employment growth 2019 to 2025 — through-the-pandemic economic momentum.

metrics.label: Startup formation rate
metrics.scoring_note: Winsorized at the 95th percentile of scored areas before ranking to damp LLC registered-agent inflation (WY/DE). High-propensity share is estimated from state-level ratios.
metrics.description: High-propensity business applications per 1,000 residents — startup formation intensity.

metrics.label: Space-industry hub
metrics.scoring_note: Curated binary flag; score is 0 or 100.
metrics.description: One of 11 curated space-industry hub metros (e.g. Denver, Colorado Springs, Boulder, Seattle, Albuquerque, Austin).

metrics.label: Value for quality
metrics.source: constructed: FHFA UAD / ACS price + stock age
metrics.description: -(z of price per sqft + z of housing-stock age): cheap AND new scores high.

metrics.label: Home price
metrics.source: Zillow ZHVI; ACS median value fallback
metrics.scoring_note: Zillow ZHVI where available (443/478); ACS 2020-2024 median value fallback for the other 35 (flagged zillow_missing).
metrics.description: Typical home value (Zillow all-homes mid-tier ZHVI).

metrics.label: Rent
metrics.source: Zillow ZORI; ACS median gross rent fallback
metrics.scoring_note: Zillow ZORI where available (391/478); ACS median gross rent fallback for the other 87 (flagged zillow_missing).
metrics.description: Typical asking rent (Zillow ZORI).

metrics.label: Effective property tax
metrics.description: Median real-estate taxes paid divided by median home value (ratio of medians, approximate).

metrics.label: Home insurance premium
metrics.scoring_note: 7/478 CBSAs unmatched; missing values imputed at the median of all scored areas before ranking (neutral).
metrics.description: Mean homeowners premium per policy, 2022.

metrics.label: Homicide rate
metrics.scoring_note: Suppressed rates (all member counties under 10 deaths over 2018-2024, 143/478) are imputed at 2.5/100k — suppressed counts imply very low rates, not unknown ones (flagged homicide_suppressed). Displayed value is blank when suppressed.
metrics.description: CBSA-wide homicide deaths per 100k person-years — the same measure for metros and micros.

metrics.label: Tokyo connectivity
metrics.scoring_note: Prescored: percentile of log1p(3 x nonstop weekly departures + best-airport one-stop capacity). Displayed value is the pre-log weighted weekly figure. US-touching segments only — one-stop routings via foreign hubs (ICN, YVR...) are not counted.
metrics.description: Weekly Tokyo access from airports within 90 mi: nonstops to HND/NRT (worth 3x) plus credible one-stop capacity via the best single airport.

metrics.label: Distance to 1M+ airport
metrics.description: Miles to the nearest airport with 1M+ annual enplanements.

metrics.label: Largest local airport
metrics.scoring_note: 6/478 CBSAs have no FAA commercial-service airport within 60 mi; missing values imputed at the median of all scored areas before ranking (neutral).
metrics.description: Enplanements at the largest FAA commercial-service airport within 60 mi.

metrics.label: State income tax ($110k benchmark)
metrics.description: Lowest state income-tax liability among the CBSA's member states, computed for a representative single filer at $110k wages (captures living on the cheap side of a state line).

metrics.label: Cost of living (RPP)
metrics.description: All-items regional price level (US = 100). Micros carry their state's nonmetro value.

metrics.label: EV home-charging cost
metrics.description: Estimated annual cost to home-charge an EV driven 12,000 mi/yr, at the state residential electricity rate.

metrics.label: Wildfire smoke days
metrics.scoring_note: Unmonitored CBSAs (201/478) imputed at the median of scored areas — unmeasured, NOT clean (flagged air_unmonitored).
metrics.description: May-October days per year with PM2.5 AQI over 100 — wildfire-smoke proxy; lost outdoor training days.

metrics.label: Natural-hazard expected loss
metrics.description: Sum of 7 per-peril expected annual loss rates (hurricane, tornado, wildfire, earthquake, flood, winter, hail), z-scored; lower is safer.

metrics.label: Winter inversion days
metrics.scoring_note: Unmonitored CBSAs (271/478) imputed at the median of scored areas (flagged air_unmonitored).
metrics.description: Nov-Feb days per season with 24hr PM2.5 over 35 µg/m³ — valley inversion smog (SLC 5.3, Fairbanks 17.8).

metrics.label: PM2.5 design value
metrics.scoring_note: Unmonitored CBSAs (286/478) imputed at the median of scored areas (flagged air_unmonitored).
metrics.description: Annual PM2.5 design value, worst monitored member county (NAAQS = 9.0).

metrics.label: Insurance non-renewal trend
metrics.scoring_note: 7/478 CBSAs unmatched; missing values imputed at the median of all scored areas before ranking (neutral).
metrics.description: Change in homeowners non-renewal rate 2018-2023 — forward-looking climate-risk signal from insurers.

metrics.label: K-12 learning rate
metrics.scoring_note: Empirical-Bayes county estimates aggregated to the CBSA weighted by test volume; CT metros use an approximate legacy-county allocation (flagged seda_approx).
metrics.description: Grade levels learned per grade year across grades 3-8 (1.0 = national pace). Growth reflects what schools add more than who attends them.

metrics.label: K-12 achievement
metrics.scoring_note: Empirical-Bayes county estimates aggregated to the CBSA weighted by test volume. Pre-pandemic vintage; post-2019 recovery data has no national county coverage yet.
metrics.description: Average grade 3-8 math + reading test-score level, in grade-level units vs the US average. Level largely tracks who lives there (parental income), which is why it is scored separately from the learning rate.

metrics.label: Research university
metrics.scoring_note: Prescored: 100 with an R1 university in the CBSA, 50 with an R2, else 0 (displayed 1 / 0.5 / 0).
metrics.description: Research-university presence under the 2025 Carnegie Research Activity Designations (187 R1 and 139 R2 institutions nationally).

metrics.label: College students per 1k
metrics.scoring_note: In-person only: exclusively-online students are excluded so virtual mega-universities (WGU, SNHU...) don't register as college towns. No institutions = a true zero, not missing data.
metrics.description: Students physically attending degree-granting colleges in the CBSA per 1,000 residents — college-town intensity.

metrics.label: Orthodox adherents
metrics.description: Eastern + Oriental Orthodox adherents per 1,000 residents.

metrics.label: Catholic adherents
metrics.description: Catholic adherents per 1,000 residents (diocesan estimates).

metrics.label: Orthodox congregation growth
metrics.description: Net change in Orthodox congregations, 2010 to 2020.

metrics.label: Altitude band 4,000-8,200 ft
metrics.scoring_note: Binary: principal-city elevation 4,000-8,200 ft (48/478); score is 0 or 100; group contributes a flat +2 when true.
metrics.description: Principal city sits in the altitude-training residence band (train-high benefit, à la pro training grounds).

flags.label: Humidity caution
flags.description: Jul-Aug 3pm dew point in the 60-65°F caution band — passes the summer-humidity screen, but noticeably muggier summers than the driest areas.

flags.label: Humidity screen unverified
flags.description: PRISM normals say the summer-humidity screen fails, but no station data could verify; kept in the scored set provisionally.

flags.label: Homicide suppressed
flags.description: CDC WONDER suppressed all member counties (<10 deaths over 2018-2024); rate imputed at 2.5/100k (suppressed counts imply very low rates). A favorable imputation for small areas.

flags.label: Partial homicide coverage
flags.description: Under 80% of CBSA population in unsuppressed counties; the homicide rate is computed over the larger counties only (mild upward bias).

flags.label: No air monitor
flags.description: No EPA monitor for at least one of smoke days / PM2.5 / winter inversions; missing values imputed at the median of scored areas (unmeasured, not clean).

flags.label: No wind data
flags.description: Station lacks daily average wind (AWND); windy days imputed at the median of scored areas.

flags.label: ACS price fallback
flags.description: Zillow ZHVI and/or ZORI unavailable; price/rent fall back to ACS 2020-2024 medians (older vintage).

flags.label: K-12 estimate approximate
flags.description: K-12 figures use an approximation: Connecticut's legacy-county data allocated to current areas by fixed population weights, or a member county absent from SEDA (e.g. DC proper).
